name: Achu
source:
Achu has been been by [url=/c20902]Hinari[/url]'s side since she was born. Its favorite place is on Hinari's shoulder, and it is the only one she feels comfortable with.

It responds subtly to human emotions and is able to heal. It is used to people, knowing that it has nothing to fear from them. However, it is unusually strong and will counterattack with a headbutt if provoked.

"Kyuuuuuun"

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=763187]Getchu[/url].]
